name: The .claude Folder: A Complete Guide 🧠
description_md:
## 
What You Get
The .claude Folder Guide (PDF)
- A 30-page reference guide covering all seven components of the .claude folder with diagrams from the video injected inline. 
- Covers the two-folder system, CLAUDE.md as a router, path-scoped rules, commands, skills, agents, permissions, hooks, and an end-to-end MeetingFlow scenario that shows everything working together.
Bash Commands Cheat Sheet (Markdown)
- 12 ready-to-run bash commands for navigating your .claude folder without leaving Claude Code. Print it, pin it, or keep it open in a tab.
MeetingFlow Demo Folder
- The complete hypothetical .claude folder from the video. Seven components, all wired together: CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, four rule files, three commands, two skills, two agents, settings.json with hooks. A working template you can adapt for your own project.
